capabilities.text: Draw a class 1, 2 or 3 lever: fulcrum, load or effort in the middle
Set the effort arm and the load arm, drawn to scale
capabilities.note: very uneven arms are drawn schematic (ratio held to 0.14–0.86) with a note saying so

capabilities.text: Measure the arms in cm, m, in or ft
Type the load as a force in N or lb, or as a mass in kg or g
Draw the load as a block on the beam or as a force arrow
Work out the effort from the load and the arms, to 3 significant figures
capabilities.note: the effort is written beside its arrow and in the key line when answers are shown

capabilities.text: Label the load with its value, your own text, a blank line, or nothing
Label the effort with its value, your own text, a blank line, or nothing
capabilities.note: the blank line is the opening (student copy); Show answers writes the value

capabilities.text: Label the effort arm with its length, your own text, a blank line, or nothing
Label the load arm with its length, your own text, a blank line, or nothing
Name the effort, leave a blank line, or leave it off
Name the load, leave a blank line, or leave it off
Name the fulcrum, leave a blank line, or leave it off
Turn the two arms' dimension lines on or off
Print an answer key with the mechanical advantage
Mirror the lever left to right
Draw in color for slides, or black and white
